description: OpenAI's efficient embedding model optimized for cost and speed. Produces 1536-dimensional embeddings with strong performance at a fraction of the cost of text-embedding-3-large.

architecture.note: Dimensions can be reduced (e.g., to 256, 512) with minimal performance loss

trainingData.description: Trained on a large corpus of text data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using contrastive learning techniques. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Strong performance at 5x lower cost than text-embedding-ada-002. Outperforms ada-002 on MTEB benchmark despite smaller size.

knownLimitations: Lower performance than text-embedding-3-large on some tasks
May not capture complex semantic relationships as well as larger model

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Embeddings may encode biases present in training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Input content filtering applied by OpenAI's usage policies.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Text sent to the API may be processed by OpenAI.
